title: Add notify-on-next-dose toggle to AddDoseDialog
name: AddDoseDialog
description: New defaultNotifyOnNextDose parameter seeds local toggle state; a Row+Switch (mirroring the existing pattern in SettingsScreen) lets the user override it per dose; onSubmit's signature grows a 4th argument carrying the chosen value. Nothing else in the dialog's existing fields/logic changes.
acceptance_criteria: New parameter defaultNotifyOnNextDose: Boolean is added to the function signature, before onDismiss
New local state: var notifyOnNextDose by remember { mutableStateOf(defaultNotifyOnNextDose) }

A new Row (verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) with a Text(stringResource(R.string.notify_on_next_dose)) weighted 1f and a Switch bound to notifyOnNextDose is added after the dose-amount OutlinedTextField
onSubmit's type becomes (profileId: Int, medicationId: Int, doseAmount: String, notifyOnNextDose: Boolean) -> Unit, and the confirm button's onClick passes notifyOnNextDose as the 4th argument
All existing fields (Who/Medication chips, dose amount field) and their behavior are unchanged
